questions.q: What does the term 'craft' primarily refer to in Cultural and Creative Arts?
options: The mass production of goods using heavy industrial machines.
The skillful use of the hands to create functional and decorative items.
The performance of traditional songs and dances during festivals.
The process of painting imaginary scenes on a canvas.
questions.explain: Craft involves the application of human skill and manual dexterity to create items that are both functional and aesthetically pleasing by hand.
